decision.observation: The denied UF entrant remains at the window (81 kg) after taking his passport. A white barcode slip sits in the ticket dispenser at bottom-left (~0.145,0.76).
decision.hypothesis: He may linger because the slot slip (possibly his ENTRY TICKET) is unopened/unreturned, as in prior stalls; if he doesn't leave, hand it back.
decision.memory: Lingering denials were usually resolved by returning the slot's white slip via GIVE.
